title: Roe Finance — Flash Loan LP Collateral Value Manipulation Analysis
root_cause: LP token collateral value computed from `getReserves()` spot price, allowing reserve manipulation within a single block to distort collateral valuation
steps: 1 ▶ Balancer flash loan (borrow large amounts of WBTC + USDC)
2 ▶ Add liquidity to UniswapV2 WBTC-USDC pair
3 ▶ Deposit LP tokens as collateral into Roe Finance
4 ▶ Borrow large amount of roeUSDC against overvalued collateral
5 ▶ Remove liquidity from UniswapV2 (redeem LP tokens)
7 ▶ Repay Balancer flash loan → borrow proceeds kept as profit
